protocol.learning: Contextual sample-mean bandit estimates time to finish charging; epsilon .2 during training only. Censored unfinished charging decisions do not update estimates.
protocol.outage: storm: station 7 offline from minute 65 through 104
protocol.dispatch: Nearest feasible idle vehicle; trip requires energy for pickup, passenger route and return to a charger plus 0.3 kWh reserve.

limitations: Stylized micro-EV fleet, not a physical vehicle model. No real charging sessions or grid data used.
Bandit is not deep RL; no performance or convergence guarantee.
Reservations approximate queue load; not a grid optimizer or enforceable booking system.
Models train at fleet size 16; evaluation at 12/24 tests limited transfer.
Zero modeled stranding under tested inputs is not an operational safety guarantee.
